command: python Tools/GameBridge/mp054_mobile_native_live.py PLAN REPORT --session OWNER [--authority SERVER] [--resume PRIOR]
scope: Actual authoritative camper TickStations, complete RCS5 station stock, native output and full native vehicle save/load; real player local or remote tool gestures.

plan_contract.checkpoints: Ordered name/actions/expect objects; actions use only observed current Bridge input selectors and expect compares exact scalar or complete count-array values from rbearnedstatus mobile.
plan_contract.historical: A checkpoint may set historical true only after a prior real original identity was captured. Reads exact immutable completion metadata; it does not certify a current native vehicle.
plan_contract.nativeReads: Optional readonly /camper or /state requests, peer owner or authority, exact args and expect dotted actual response paths. Full arrays/objects compare exactly; missing fields fail. Use real rich tools/timer/inventory before and after observations here.
plan_contract.noNewOriginal: Refusal checkpoints may set true with expect {} and nonempty nativeReads. Requires no fresh productive original plus exact observed native unchanged state.
plan_contract.cold: Separate real process or World replacement with --resume. Authority saved world stays fixed; actor and host creation, life, process and World remain fixed within each invocation.
plan_contract.identity: Operation, birth, original SHA, VIN and immutable earned recipient must stay identical. A paid successor is independently captured with its actual parentOperation.

native_cases.name: full-count-initial-return
native_cases.setup: Actual camper stock includes a native supported count above65535 and real material/fuel station work.

native_cases.name: last-fuel-output
native_cases.setup: Real final paid work uses last fuel; observe the actual enclosing TickMobile return.

native_cases.name: partial-carryover
native_cases.setup: Real saved native output retains unfinished next work.
assert: exact partial tools/timer through actual camper state
marker clearing proceeds to native clear save without reentering completed successor

native_cases.name: paid-child
native_cases.setup: Saved pending debt can fully pay the next native completion.
assert: actual child parentOperation equals captured parent

native_cases.name: child-origin-publication-refusal
native_cases.setup: An independently established publication refusal leaves the exact prepared child pending; after that refusal is cleared, continue the same original through its genuine native owning tick.
assert: no successor timer/tool effect while child source publication is refused
same child operation and original digest on retry
saved complete child source before native successor work
no duplicate tool wear or output

native_cases.name: local-exhausted-tools
native_cases.setup: Use actual native tool-grid remove/place gestures with a saved exhausted-tool pending original.
assert: toolsSaved true only after native owner/returned station sync/vehicle save

native_cases.name: remote-exhausted-tools
native_cases.setup: Independent remote owner performs actual remove/place gestures; authority observes original saved RCJ and native vehicle.

native_cases.name: remote-tools-payer-mismatch
native_cases.setup: With a genuine pending paid tools source, independently establish a retry or journal terminal whose payer account/creation differs from that immutable source; preserve real owner/vehicle snapshots for comparison.
assert: different payer cannot reuse pending source
no tools setter or native owner debit replay
journal terminal with different payer or Before/After digests cannot release original
exact native owner and station state unchanged

native_cases.name: cold-paid-tools-before-sink
native_cases.setup: Real saved owner native receipt and immutable original exist; authority cold-loads native vehicle Before while original RCJ remains Uncertain.
assert: tools sink alone finishes under real owning tick

native_cases.name: cold-tools-after-sink
native_cases.setup: Actual loaded vehicle contains full original tools After, matching immutable saved owner native receipt.

native_cases.name: cold-paid-tools-second-restart
native_cases.setup: After genuine paid-tools reentry wrote its original reentry/invoking receipts and native vehicle After, cold-load the same authority again before marker release.
assert: reentry companion receipts remain attached to the same original transfer
no second owner debit or tools setter
no orphan or changed companion accepted

native_cases.name: cold-source-file-bound
native_cases.setup: Use disposable CodexTest metadata copies with an empty, oversized, truncated or partial-publication mobile source record before a genuine cold vehicle load; preserve the original source for comparison.
assert: no owner debit or tools/output replay
exact native owner and station state unchanged
source allocation stays within the opened handle bound
valid original resumes only through its existing native source

native_cases.name: payer-detached
native_cases.setup: Tool payer leaves or dies before final save; continuation uses the genuine saved payer original and native installed source, with actual new viewer separately scoped.

native_cases.name: release-positive-prefix
native_cases.setup: Real cold boundary between marker-clear native save and final release metadata, and between child initial-source publication and parent release.

native_cases.name: uncertain-output-held
native_cases.setup: Actual output invocation entered without a positive genuine returned terminal; cold authority loads.
assert: no synthetic original or earned callback

native_cases.name: full-output-admission
native_cases.setup: Actual output grid cannot fit native primary plus configured additional result before final paid work.

limitations: Requires real input plans selected from observed current UI, external native save/network barriers and genuine cold loads.

Readonly mobile Boolean/count observer does not itself expose native owner invocation counts; exact actual camper/state fields must be supplied through nativeReads for full rich inventory/tools/timer assertions.
No native runtime, fixture, compiler, parser or gameplay execution has been performed.
